# Ahmed Mahmoud Portfolio

> Professional portfolio for Ahmed Mahmoud, a tourism operations and product operations specialist in Abu Dhabi. The site presents field-based thinking across DMC operations, dispatch planning, stargazing operations, quotation discipline, guide quality, and destination experience design.

## Primary Sections

- Home: https://ahmedqualityops.com/
- Projects: https://ahmedqualityops.com/projects.html
- Insights Library: https://ahmedqualityops.com/articles.html
- Professional Background: https://ahmedqualityops.com/experience/
- Contact: https://ahmedqualityops.com/#contact

## Flagship Projects

- InfraDispatch: https://ahmedqualityops.com/infradispatch/
  - Static live beta/demo for rule-based tourism transport dispatch planning, pickup/drop-off sequencing, team briefings, Google Maps route links and print-ready manifests.
- InfraCluster: https://ahmedqualityops.com/infracluster.html
  - Static MVP for UAE hotel pickup and drop-off clustering, spreadsheet import, group timing, guide-language matching, vehicle alternatives, estimated cost signals, a 7,500+ row static UAE tourism seed database and InfraDispatch handoff outputs.
- InfraSky: https://ahmedqualityops.com/infrasky.html
  - Static planning system for UAE stargazing product decisions, guest promise control, season filters, constellation planning, and field operations briefs.
- InfraQuote: https://ahmedqualityops.com/infraquote.html
  - Static DMC quotation and costing tool for city-tour costing, margin review, guest requirements, transport assumptions, and client-ready quotation structure.
